title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Fixed a stuck-matching bug: guest matching now correctly forgets a DC-crawled recruitment post once joining it actually fails (e.g. the run already started), instead of retrying that same dead post forever on every poll cycle whenever it was the only candidate around.
